list.snippet: Cuff & Bangle Bracelets: Open-ended metal designs, often made of stainless steel with 18K gold or silver plating, featuring wrap-around Arabic calligraphy. Prices range from £14 to £35 from specialty boutiques like Al Huda Jewellery.

Braided Rope & Charm Bracelets: Casual, adjustable unisex designs with a stainless steel centerpiece engraved with the verse. These are widely available on platforms like Amazon starting around £2 to £8.
Maintenance: Most metal pieces use durable stainless steel or gold plating, but it is best to wipe them with a soft cloth and avoid harsh chemicals or prolonged water exposure to maintain the finish.

Respectful Wear: Because the jewelry bears sacred Quranic text, some Islamic scholars advise removing the bracelet before entering restrooms or engaging in certain activities out of respect for the sanctity of the words.
